caption: The video captures a close-up of a reddish-brown clay vessel on a spinning pottery wheel, its shoulder and open mouth turning while the wheel head shows rotational blur. A pink caliper-style tool rests against the vessel's upper-right shoulder, its handle extending off the right edge. In the blurred background, a seated potter in a gray shirt and green pants keeps wet hands hovering above the clay without clear contact. Then an arm and hand sweep across the front of the vessel from the left, occluding the spinning clay before withdrawing toward the lower right. After this pass, a hand holding a green sponge enters from the left and presses it against the wheel head beside the vessel's base. The sponge wipes that lower area as the wheel turns, the hand remaining there while the wheel keeps turning. Throughout, the caliper's contact point and the vessel's silhouette stay essentially unchanged as the process continues.
relations: Left arm sweeping across the spinning vessel occludes its front, then withdraws toward lower right without altering clay shape.
Green sponge pressed to wheel head beside the base wipes that lower area while the wheel continues rotating.
Caliper contact on the upper-right shoulder and vessel silhouette persist essentially unchanged throughout the wiping pass.
